topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Oh, you should totally do it! Think of all the tomatoes and zucchini we could share come harvest time. It’s such a good idea, and our yard’s got more sun than yours. Plus, I've been meaning to get into gardening myself. Having a partner in this could be just the encouragement I need. We can swap tips, maybe even start some flowers. It’s gonna be great! Can't wait to get my hands dirty and see what we can grow together. Let’s plan it out soon, yeah?
